title: Poincare conjecture
statement: Every closed simply connected 3-manifold is homeomorphic to the 3-sphere.
how_it_was_proved: Perelman (2002-2003), completing Hamilton's programme of Ricci flow with surgery, in the account of Morgan and Tian. The Lean 4 formalization of Zhang, Delaval, Chen, Chen, Xu, Liao, Jiang, Liu and Dong was written with AI assistance.

sources.cite: Z. Zhang et al., An AI-assisted formalization of the Poincare conjecture, arXiv:2610.08329
The Poincare conjecture in Lean 4: built and checked, Zenodo

steps.statement: Surgery at the singular times, with canonical neighbourhoods
steps.how: each singularity is cut out and the flow restarted: the residual move repeated, finitely often on each finite interval

steps.statement: For simply connected manifolds the flow with surgery becomes extinct in finite time
